Name: ChasePlane
Description: Switch ChasePlane (MSFS 2024) camera views from your Stream Deck. Pick any Internal, External or World view; the key lights up while that view is active.

fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.cinematic.Name: Cinematic

fr.stalexcorp.msfschaseplane.flashlight.Name: Flashlight
